explanation: Wanless (2011), Theorem 7.2: for n ≥ 5, 15^{n/5} ≤ T(n) ≤ c^n √n n! with c = √((3−√3)/6) · e^{√3/6} ≈ 0.6135, where T(n) is the maximum number of transversals over latin squares of order n. T is defined as that maximum over the finite type of latin squares, and the bounds use real exponent n/5. Matches. Faithful.
